news.title: Anfield, intensity, rotation - how Iraola is improving Liverpool
news.summary: Liverpool fans are finding joy at Anfield again with a feel-good factor around the club before the visit of reigning champions Arsenal on Sunday.

news.title: Are Manchester United really at risk of a relegation scrap?
news.summary: Manchester United's current tally of seven points from nine games would not even get them 30 points if it was continued for the full season.

news.summary: Lisandro Martinez is sent off for Manchester United as they suffer a 2-0 defeat against Chelsea at Stamford Bridge to pile more pressure on under-fire manager Michael Carrick.

news.title: Brighton pick up first away league victory over Man City
news.summary: Brighton pick up their first away league victory at Manchester City, winning 1-0 to condemn City to a second successive Premier League defeat.

news.title: Coventry out of bottom three with win over struggling Sunderland
news.summary: Frank Lampard's Coventry City lift themselves out of the relegation zone after beating struggling Sunderland, who remain rooted to the bottom of the Premier League table.

news.title: Enciso's stunning goal earns Ipswich draw at Hull
news.summary: Julio Enciso scores the equalising goal for Ipswich as they draw 2-2 with Hull at the MKM Stadium.

news.title: Spurs revival continues with victory over 10-man Crystal Palace
news.summary: Jean-Philippe Mateta was shown an early red card as Crystal Palace lose 2-0 at Tottenham to increase the pressure on manager Pierre Sage.

news.title: Evanilson scores again as Bournemouth beat Leeds
news.summary: Forward Evanilson continues his fine goalscoring form by netting in a fourth Premier League match in a row to help Bournemouth defeat Leeds United at the Vitality Stadium.

news.title: Thiago on target as Brentford beat Forest
news.summary: Igor Thiago's second-half goal helps Brentford to their first win in five as they beat Nottingham Forest 2-0 at the Gtech Community Stadium.

news.title: Suzuki mistake gifts Fulham point at Villa
news.summary: Aston Villa goalkeeper Zion Suzuki's second-half mistake sees Fulham secure a 1-1 draw at Villa Park after Nicolas Jackson had given the hosts the lead.

news.title: Suzuki makes string of saves before conceding own goal in draw with Fulham
news.summary: Nicolas Jackson scored his eighth goal in 10 games but an error from goalkeeper Zion Suzuki meant Aston Villa had to settle for a 1-1 draw at home to Fulham.

news.title: Are De Zerbi's Spurs finding elusive consistency?
news.summary: Are Spurs finally finding elusive consistency under Roberto de Zerbi after a third successive Premier League win, asks chief football writer Phil McNulty?

news.title: Verbruggen spreads belief as impressive Brighton beat Man City
news.summary: Goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen was the man of the moment on Saturday afternoon as he produced an impressive individual display to help Brighton beat Manchester City
